mode.description: Mode is poll (run every interval) or stream (one long-lived process).

interval.description:
Interval and Timeout are a poll watcher's: how often it runs, and how
long one poll may take.

executable.description:
Executable is the app's copy, the one that runs; Checksum its SHA-256
(trust is keyed to it).

env.description: Env is the environment variable it's passed as.

items.description: ProgramSecret is a secret a program declares, and whether it's stored (`auth login <program>` stores it).

enabled.description: Enabled is false while it's paused.

hooks.description:
Hooks are the hooks that listen to it; it runs while one of them is
on (and it's trusted and not paused).

lastPollAt.description:
LastPollAt is when a poll last worked; StartedAt when its stream last
started; LastEventAt when it last printed a new event.

error.description:
Error is why its last poll failed or its stream last ended early
(cleared once it works again, or a permission it needs changes), and
ErrorAt when.

label.description: Label is what the OS calls it (Input Monitoring).

state.description:
State is what the scheduler last found: granted, missing, unknown (it
can't be checked), unsupported (not on this OS) or not-checked
(nothing recorded yet). Only missing and not-checked keep it from
running.

items.description: PermissionSource is what declares a permission something needs: a plugin it uses, its own program (a program's, a program hook's) or its watcher.

where.description:
Where says where it's turned on, following "turn it on" ("in System
Settings > Privacy & Security > Input Monitoring"), and SettingsURL is
the address that opens it (absent where there's none).

items.description: PermissionNeed is a permission something needs, what declares it, and what the scheduler last found.

permissions.description:
Permissions are what the OS must allow it, as its file declares, with
what the scheduler last found: it isn't started while one isn't
granted. Absent when none.

label.description: Label is what it means, in words ("End key pressed").

hooks.description:
Hooks are the hooks that act on it: those listening for its type, and
those listening for every type.

items.description: WatcherEvent is an event a watcher declares, with the hooks that act on it.

events.description:
Events are the events it declares it prints, in its file's order,
each with its label and the hooks that act on it. Absent when it
declares none: it may print any type (Hint says so).

hint.description:
Hint is a nudge about how it's written that doesn't keep it from
running (it doesn't declare its events): never a problem.

title: procauto watchers show --json
description: WatcherDetail is `watchers show --json`: a watcher with its description file's source.
